content.text:
### Use reset: false with goto

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-errors/navigation.md

Replaces the removed `noScroll` and `keepFocus` options. Pass `reset: false` to preserve both scroll position and focused element during navigation.

```javascript
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';

await goto('/somewhere', { reset: false });
```

--------------------------------

### goto_options_removed

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-errors/navigation.md

## goto_options_removed

> The `goto(..., { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true })` options have been replaced by `reset: false`

[`goto`](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/$app-navigation#goto) no longer accepts separate `noScroll` and `keepFocus` options. Pass `reset: false` instead, which preserves both the scroll position and the focused element:

--------------------------------

### link_option_replaced

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-warnings/links.md

## link_option_replaced

> `data-sveltekit-%name%="true"` has been replaced with `data-sveltekit-reset="false"`

The `data-sveltekit-keepfocus` and `data-sveltekit-noscroll` [link options](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/link-options) have been combined into [`data-sveltekit-reset`](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/link-options#data-sveltekit-reset). Replace them with `data-sveltekit-reset="false"`, which preserves both the scroll position and the focused element. The element is logged alongside this warning.

--------------------------------

### `$app/navigation` > `goto` options are updated

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/documentation/docs/60-appendix/35-migrating-to-sveltekit-3.md

### `goto` options are updated

In addition to the new `shallow` option described [above](#$app-navigation-Changes-to-shallow-routing), various [`goto`]($app-navigation#goto) options have changed:

- `invalidateAll` is now `refreshAll`, to mirror the [above change](#$app-navigation-invalidateAll-is-deprecated-in-favour-of-refreshAll)
- `keepFocus: true` and `noScroll: true` have been combined as `reset: false`
- `replaceState` is now `replace`

--------------------------------

### Replace replaceState with goto using shallow routing and replace

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-warnings/navigation.md

Use `goto` from `$app/navigation` with `shallow: true` and `replace: true` to replace `replaceState` calls, preserving the same state object.

```js
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';

// instead of replaceState('/photos/1', { selected: 1 })
await goto('/photos/1', { state: { selected: 1 }, shallow: true, replace: true });
```

content.text:
The recipe list now has a search box that filters by title, and `npm run check` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. I haven't run the app in a browser, so the filtering and the URL update are untested.

- **Filtering** (`src/routes/+page.ts`): the load function reads `?q=` from the URL and returns the recipes whose title contains it, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. An empty or missing `q` shows every recipe.
- **Search box** (`src/routes/+page.svelte`): it filters as you type and rewrites the URL to `?q=…`. Clearing the box removes `?q`. It replaces the current history entry rather than adding one per keystroke, and keeps focus and scroll position. This follows the SvelteKit 3.1.1 docs from Context7, where `goto` takes `replace: true` and `reset: false`.
- **Sharing**: opening a link like `/?q=soup` pre-fills the box and shows the filtered list. The input is inside a plain `GET` form, so pressing Enter still filters if JavaScript is off.
- **No matches**: the list shows "No recipes match “…”."
